limitations: Original Flash/BOOT contents were masked by read protection before unlocking. Pre-unlock flash and boot dumps are masked data, not firmware backups.
Read-protection removal mass-erased user Flash. Original firmware is no longer recoverable from this device.
RAM and register reads are sequential snapshots and include debug access effects, not an atomic CPU-state backup.
All documented flash/system ranges and available memory/register interfaces were collected; unconnected external storage and undocumented address space were not scanned.
Successful register reads alone do not establish that every probed CSR is implemented; reserved/unsupported addresses may return zero.
The CLI does not register family 0xa6 and warns about the part of total Flash exceeding its zero-wait memory map. Total Flash address range was taken from the local WCH reference manual.
576KiB zero-wait Flash and nominal 200KiB SRAM should not be treated as a verified simultaneous allocation; SRAM split needs a separate test.
